text: Whole breast irradiation of 40 Gy in 15 fractions following lumpectomy with a sequential boost of 10 Gy in 4 fractions to the tumor bed.
notes: Breast hypofractionated whole breast RT. Standard UK/Canadian regimen.

text: Right breast tangential fields with deep inspiration breath hold to 50 Gy in 25 fractions including the supraclavicular fossa and level three axilla.
notes: Breast with regional nodal irradiation. Tests 'supraclavicular' and 'axilla' vocabulary.

text: Definitive prostate VMAT to 78 Gy in 39 fractions with simultaneous integrated boost to the intraprostatic lesion to 82 Gy.
notes: Prostate definitive RT with SIB. Tests 'intraprostatic' vocabulary.

text: Post-prostatectomy radiation to the prostate bed of 66 Gy in 33 fractions with fiducial marker image guidance and rectal SpaceOAR hydrogel in situ.
notes: Post-prostatectomy salvage. Tests 'SpaceOAR' and 'fiducial' vocabulary.

text: External beam radiation to the pelvis of 45 Gy in 25 fractions with concurrent weekly cisplatin followed by intracavitary brachytherapy using tandem and ovoids.
notes: Cervix definitive chemoRT + brachy. Tests 'intracavitary', 'tandem and ovoids'.

text: Cervical cancer treated with 50.4 Gy in 28 fractions to the primary and pelvic nodes with parametrial boost to 60 Gy and HDR brachytherapy of 7 Gy times 4 fractions to point A.
notes: Cervix with parametrial boost + HDR brachy. Tests 'parametrial' and 'point A'.

text: Long course neoadjuvant chemoradiation of 50.4 Gy in 28 fractions to the rectum and mesorectum with concurrent capecitabine prior to total mesorectal excision.
notes: Rectal neoadjuvant long course. Tests 'mesorectum' and 'total mesorectal excision'.

text: Short course preoperative radiation of 25 Gy in 5 fractions to the rectal primary and mesorectal lymph nodes followed by delayed surgery at 8 weeks.
notes: Rectal short course. Lower dose density, tests 'mesorectal' in a different context.

text: Definitive chemoradiation for squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal with dose painting to 54 Gy to the primary and 36 Gy to elective inguinal nodes with concurrent mitomycin-C and 5-fluorouracil.
notes: Anal canal Nigro-type chemoRT. Tests 'inguinal', 'mitomycin-C', 'dose painting'.

text: Anal margin carcinoma treated with IMRT to 50 Gy in 25 fractions to the primary with concurrent 5-FU and elective coverage of the bilateral inguinal and internal iliac nodes.
notes: Anal margin. Tests 'internal iliac' and '5-FU' abbreviation.

text: Adjuvant pelvic radiation for vulvar squamous cell carcinoma of 45 Gy in 25 fractions with boost to 54 Gy to the vulvar tumor bed and bilateral inguinofemoral nodes.
notes: Vulvar adjuvant. Tests 'vulvar' and 'inguinofemoral'.

text: Vaginal cuff HDR brachytherapy of 7 Gy times 3 fractions prescribed to 5 millimeters depth following total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy.
notes: Vaginal cuff brachy. Tests 'salpingo-oophorectomy' — extreme multi-syllable medical term.

text: Adjuvant radiation for endometrial carcinoma of 45 Gy in 25 fractions to the pelvis with a vaginal cuff boost using HDR brachytherapy of 6 Gy times 2 fractions.
notes: Endometrial adjuvant EBRT + brachy. Tests 'endometrial carcinoma'.

text: Endometrial cancer pelvic IMRT of 50.4 Gy in 28 fractions with concurrent carboplatin and paclitaxel for stage IIIC1 disease with para-aortic nodal involvement.
notes: Endometrial advanced stage with chemo. Tests 'carboplatin', 'paclitaxel', 'para-aortic'.

text: Adjuvant para-aortic strip radiation for stage IIB seminoma of 20 Gy in 10 fractions following left radical orchidectomy.
notes: Testicular seminoma adjuvant. Tests 'orchidectomy' and 'para-aortic strip'.

text: Dog-leg field radiation for stage IIA seminoma of 30 Gy in 15 fractions covering the para-aortic and ipsilateral iliac nodes following orchidectomy.
notes: Testicular dog-leg. Tests 'dog-leg field' and 'ipsilateral iliac'.

text: Partial penile irradiation with HDR brachytherapy using an interstitial implant to 60 Gy for a T1 squamous cell carcinoma of the glans penis.
notes: Penile brachy. Tests 'glans penis' and 'interstitial implant'.

text: External beam radiation to the penis and bilateral inguinal nodes of 45 Gy in 25 fractions with a boost to the primary of 64.8 Gy using IMRT.
notes: Penile EBRT. Decimal dose (64.8). Tests combined inguinal + penile vocabulary.

text: Head and neck IMRT for oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma of 70 Gy in 35 fractions to the primary with 56 Gy to the elective bilateral cervical and retropharyngeal nodes.
notes: Head and neck SCC. Tests 'oropharyngeal' and 'retropharyngeal' — complex anatomical terms.

text: Definitive chemoradiation for locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer of 60 Gy in 30 fractions with concurrent carboplatin and paclitaxel followed by durvalumab consolidation.
notes: Lung NSCLC chemoRT + immunotherapy. Tests 'durvalumab' — newer drug name.
